metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET badges for eco-friendly branding. Durable, sustainable, and perfect for bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled PET badges offer an eco-conscious alternative to traditional plastic badges without sacrificing durability or print quality. Made from post-consumer recycled materials, these badges are ideal for companies prioritizing sustainability in their promotional products. Whether you need employee ID badges, event credentials, or branded lanyard attachments, recycled PET provides a smooth surface for vibrant full-color imprinting. Choose this material to align your brand with environmental responsibility while maintaining a professional appearance.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET badges with full-color imprint, ideal for eco-friendly employee ID and event credentials
